timeline.labelEn: Canaan Banana, first President of Zimbabwe (1980–1987)

questions.notes: Multiple-choice options removed. Canaan Sodindo Banana held the then largely ceremonial presidency 1980–1987; Robert Mugabe was prime minister and became executive president in 1987.

questions.de: Wie hoch war der Koloss von Rhodos, eines der sieben antiken Weltwunder, ungefähr?
questions.en: Roughly how tall was the Colossus of Rhodes, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World?

timeline.labelEn: The Colossus of Rhodes, a bronze statue of Helios by Chares of Lindos, is completed
timeline.labelDe: Der Koloss von Rhodos, eine Bronzestatue des Helios von Chares von Lindos, wird fertiggestellt

questions.notes: Card statement is true: the Colossus stood about 70 cubits (~33 m), roughly two-thirds the height of the Statue of Liberty from feet to crown (the copper statue alone is 46 m). Accept answers around 30–35 m.

questions.cardDe: Welches war der Name der ersten Internet-Suchmaschine?
questions.de: Welches war der Name der ersten Internet-Suchmaschine?
questions.en: What was the name of the first internet search engine?

timeline.labelEn: Alan Emtage's Archie, an index of FTP archives, is released
timeline.labelDe: Alan Emtages Archie, ein Suchindex für FTP-Archive, wird veröffentlicht

questions.notes: Archie indexed FTP archives and is generally considered the first internet search engine; the first web search engines (e.g. W3Catalog, ALIWEB) followed in 1993.

questions.en: In which sport did the first woman win an Olympic medal at the start of the 20th century?

timeline.labelEn: Hélène de Pourtalès wins Olympic sailing gold in Paris, the first woman to win an Olympic medal
timeline.labelDe: Hélène de Pourtalès gewinnt bei den Spielen von Paris olympisches Gold im Segeln – als erste Frau eine olympische Medaille

questions.notes: Multiple-choice options removed. Swiss sailor Hélène de Pourtalès won gold in the 1–2 ton class (race of 22 May 1900), weeks before tennis player Charlotte Cooper's individual title.
